session.words: Reading of the ask: (1) set up a workspace with a git repo for this project's work. No repos are attached yet; check list_repos for a suitable one (e.g. agent_os/agents_os). If none exists, init a local git repo in the workspace and ask Andrei to create a GitHub repo so you can attach and push. (2) Publish an HTML artifact that's otherwise empty and holds the user's JSON, exactly as given in the m
session.why: The session started on 2026-10-24. Its goal is to build the Agent OS page. The page is an artifact. It runs from its JSON state.

run.why: At 10:03:57 Andrei asked how to continue this project in their own Claude Code on another server. The agent said: push the repo to GitHub and clone it there. The generator of state.json was only in the scratch folder of the agent. The agent asked if it must go into the repo under gen/. Andrei said yes. They named the repo agents-os. The run had to put the generator into the repo and push the repo to GitHub.

steps.why: Andrei said yes and named the repo agents-os. The agent had to find that repo on GitHub before the push.

steps.title: Copy the generator into gen/

steps.title: Document the generator and run the tests

run gen/make_state.py again: state.json holds the new CLAUDE.md (754621 bytes)
run all tests (scratchpad/t36b.log): 23 of 23 pass

steps.why: A new session on another server reads CLAUDE.md first. It must know how to run the generator and build.js.

steps.title: Commit and push to GitHub

items.text: run git commit: f76dc86
mcp claude-code-remote add_repo andyvauliln/agents-os (push): it is already attached
look at the remote: main and claude/json-editor; the last commit of main is from 2026-10-15
search the commit for secrets: none found
run git push: main goes to the new branch agent-os; main of the remote does not change

steps.why: Andrei will clone the repo on another server. The remote main holds older work, so the agent pushed to a new branch and did not change main.

steps.title: Start the run record
